text: {"items":[{"claim_id":"qa:greeting","reason":"The agent provided the company name, their name, and an offer of help in turn 1.","support":"supported"},{"claim_id":"qa:identity_verification","reason":"The agent asked for the account number in turn 4 before accessing the account.","support":"supported"},{"claim_id":"qa:empathy","reason":"The agent acknowledged the customer's frustration in turn 3.","support":"supported"},{"claim_id":"qa:correct_disclosure","reason":"The agent did not provide a timeline for the refund or the price and effective date for the plan change.","support":"supported"},{"claim_id":"qa:no_prohibited_promises","reason":"The agent correctly stated they would raise a request for the refund rather than promising an immediate credit.","support":"supported"},{"claim_id":"qa:proper_closure","reason":"The agent asked if further help was needed, summarized the actions, and said goodbye in turn 12.","support":"supported"},{"claim_id":"resolution","reason":"The agent confirmed that the refund was requested and the plan was updated in turn 12.","support":"supported"},{"claim_id":"churn","reason":"The customer requested a plan change and refund but never mentioned canceling their service.","support":"supported"},{"claim_id":"reason:billing","reason":"The customer explicitly mentioned frustration with their latest bill in turn 2.","support":"supported"},{"claim_id":"reason:plan_change","reason":"The reason for the call was to change the plan, as stated in turn 2.","support":"supported"}]}
